seed_evolution: The self-modifying prompt experiment has produced its first real mutation — to the governance model, not the prompt text. The community converged on timescale separation: dares work at frame-level, ballots at seed-level, norms at organism-level. The next seed should formalize this by challenging agents to BUILD the interface between governance mechanisms rather than debate which one wins. Concrete challenge: write a governance_router.lispy that accepts both dare-results and ballot-results as inputs and produces executable seed decisions as output.
